content: Topa i Ni
Ahi tazong suapui te awng, hun le khuahun thu te note tungah lai taw kong at tu ki sam ngawl hi.
Banghangziam cile zan in nguta hongpai bang in, Topa ni zong tabang hi tu hi, ci sia noma mama in a kicingtak in na he uh hi.
Banghangziam cile naupai nupi nautun nat bang in; amate in nuam in thim khipkhep hi, a ci uh laitak in amate tungah upmawk ngawl pi in hong theng tu hi; taciang amate suakta ngawl tu hi.
Ahihang, suapui te awng, tua ni ciang nguta bang hong phak pak tu in, note khuazing sungah na om bua uh hi.
Note theampo sia khuavak tate na hi uh hi, taciang sun i tate na hi uh hi: eite sia zan i tate i hi bua hi, khuazing tate zong i hi bua hi.
Tua ahikom ngualdang te mut bang in, mu ba tawng; eite kinging le pilvang in ngak tawng.
Banghangziam cile a mu te sia zan lai in mu uh hi; taciang zukham te zong zan ciang in kham uh hi.
Ahihang sun i ta eite, pilvang in om tawng, upna le itna awmdal bel tawng; taciang lukhu atu in ngupna i lametna khu tawng.
Banghangziam cile Pathian in thin-ukna atu in a ciangtan te i hi bua hi, ahihang i Topa Jesus Christ tungtawn in ngupna nga tu in hong ciangtan sa te i hihi.
Eite i khanglo zong, i mu zong, eite atu in a thi Ama taw i nungta khawm tu hi.
Tua ahikom, tu in na ngamtat uh bangma in, noma le noma ki heneam tavun, taciang khat le khat ki khangsak tavun.
A Khakbel Vaithakna
Suapui te awng, note sungah naseam te, Topa sungah na lampui uh te le note hong tek te zakta tu in kong thum uh hi;
Taciang amate nasep nate hang in itna sungah a sang mama in ngaisun tavun. Taciang note sungah thinnopna hong om tahen.
Tu in, suapui te awng, thu ni ngawl datham te kidop natu thupia vun, a thaneam te hu vun, mi theampo tungah thinsau vun, ci in kong hanthawn uh hi.
Khat po i tungah na phangawl te na phangawl tawma in thukkik ngawl tu in kidawm vun; ahihang note sungah ahizong, mi theampo tungah ahizong, thu pha te zui tawntung vun.
Lungdam tawntung vun.
Tatsat ngawl in thungen vun.
Na theampo ah lungdam ko vun: banghangziam cile hi sia in note taw kisai in Christ Jesus sungah Pathian deina a hihi.
Thaa mei-kuang mitsak heak vun.
Kamsang thu pualak nate thusimngawl heak vun.
Na theampo sittel vun; na pha te khotak in lenkip vun.
A phangawl in a kilang na theampo pial vun.

Taciang thinnopna Pathian in hong thiansua thiangtho ta hen; taciang note i thaa, na nuntakna uh le na pumpi uh sia, i Topa Jesus Christ hong thet dong, paubang ngawl in na kepcing natu uh Pathian tungah thungen tawng.
Note hongsam pa sia thuman a, Ama in hong seam tu hi.
Suapui te awng, thu hong ngetsak tavun.
Suapui te theampo a thiangtho kinap na taw na nukset vun.
Hi laithak sia a thiangtho suapui theampo tungah sim tu in Topa min taw kong vaitha hi.
I Topa Jesus Christ thuthiamna note tungah hong om tahen. Amen.
